# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

The [latest](https://github.com/kurosakishigure/katharsis/releases/latest) version of Katharsis on GitHub supports immediate security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please use [security.txt](https://hqsy.net/.well-known/security.txt) to report a vulnerability.

You can expect a response within 48 hours if you are a human reporting a genuine issue.

Thank you in advance.
